### U.S. Bancorp Announces New U.S. Bancorp Global Funds Brand


October 29, 2026


- [Download PDF (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/711684571/files/doc_news/U-S--Bancorp-Announces-New-U-S--Bancorp-Global-Funds-Brand-2026.pdf)


The platform also introduces its first offshore liquidity fund, domiciled in Ireland


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


U.S. Bancorp today announced its new fund platform, **U.S. Bancorp Global Funds** , and its first offering, an offshore liquidity fund domiciled in Ireland, the **U.S. Bancorp Liquidity – USD Treasury CNAV Fund** .


U.S. Bancorp Global Funds was created to support U.S. Bancorp’s growing international presence. It establishes a framework for future investment offerings and reflects U.S. Bancorp’s expanding presence in global markets. Investment products offered under the brand are established through U.S. Bancorp Global Funds ICAV, an Ireland-domiciled UCITS umbrella fund structure. The U.S. Bancorp Liquidity – USD Treasury CNAV Fund is the first offering introduced under the new brand.


The U.S. Bancorp Liquidity – USD Treasury CNAV Fund is designed for investors outside the United States seeking to preserve capital while accessing a U.S. Treasury-focused liquidity solution within a regulated offshore structure. Domiciled in Ireland as a UCITS fund, it invests primarily in short-term U.S. Treasury securities and Treasury-backed repurchase agreements, combining the globally recognized UCITS framework with the liquidity and credit quality of U.S. Treasury investments.


The fund highlights the broad capabilities of the bank’s affiliate structure, with U.S. Bancorp Asset Management acting as the investment manager, U.S. Bank Global Fund Services (Ireland) Limited as fund administrator and U.S. Bank Europe DAC providing depositary services. Carne Global Fund Managers (Ireland) Limited is the ICAV’s designated management company with the Central Bank of Ireland.


Eric Thole, CEO of U.S. Bancorp Asset Management, said, "The launch of this fund is an important step in bringing our liquidity management expertise to investors outside the United States. Combined with the introduction of U.S. Bancorp Global Funds, it establishes a foundation for expanding our investment capabilities and serving a broader range of investors globally."


Patrick O’Brien, head of Business Development, Ireland at Carne Group said, “We are delighted to have been selected by U.S. Bancorp to act as the designated management company for its new fund. We look forward to bringing our multi-jurisdictional expertise and specialist governance, oversight and infrastructure to this partnership and supporting U.S. Bancorp’s ambitious plans to expand its European footprint.”


**About U.S. Bancorp**


Headquartered in Minneapolis, U.S. Bancorp is the parent company of U.S. Bank National Association, the fifth-largest commercial bank in the United States. Our three major business lines serve 15 million clients globally, and our team of nearly 70,000 people invest our hearts and minds to power human potential every day. Ranked 110th on the Fortune 500, we are deeply respected for our culture and long-term stewardship and admired for our diversified business mix and product capabilities.


**About U.S. Bancorp Asset Management**


U.S. Bancorp Asset Management’s core strength and focus is managing investment grade fixed income strategies for institutional clients. A registered investment adviser, it has been providing investment grade fixed income investment solutions since 1982. With more than $425 billion in assets under management as of Sept. 30, 2026, U.S. Bancorp Asset Management is a resource for institutional clients including corporations, healthcare organizations, higher education, public entities and nonprofits. For more information, visit[usbancorpassetmanagement.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.usbancorpassetmanagement.com%2F&esheet=54630999&newsitemid=20261029467091&lan=en-US&anchor=usbancorpassetmanagement.com&index=1&md5=4dda67f032384f766e63e30f04e447d8) .


**About Carne Group**


Carne Group takes care of the people who take care of money. Founded in 2004, today Carne is Europe’s largest third-party management company. We support asset managers through every element of the fund lifecycle, including risk, compliance, due diligence, oversight, distribution and governance. Backed by digital capabilities and infrastructure built over two decades, our dedicated and expert team provides peace of mind for our clients and their investors, simplifying and strengthening the ways their funds operate. We partner with around 700 clients, from boutique firms to the majority of the world’s 20 largest fund managers – supporting funds distributed in over 160 countries and overseeing more than US$1 trillion assets under management. Carne employs more than 650 employees across eight locations globally.
